question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I am thinking about colouring my ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hair**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**hair**" refers to the strands growing on the head or body. (बाल)
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is thinking about coloring their hair, which makes "**hair**" the most appropriate word.
 
• The other options: "**heir**", "**hare**", and "**air**", do not fit the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *I am thinking about colouring my hair__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Heir (उत्तराधिकारी)**: refers to a person legally entitled to inherit property or a title.
 
• **Hare (खरगोश)**: refers to a fast-running mammal resembling a rabbit.
 
• **Air (हवा)**: refers to the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the Earth.
